issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Hey Noah
products.tagline: A proactive AI executive assistant for founders
products.summaryZh: 面向创始人的主动式AI行政助理
products.descriptionZh: Noah是一款为创始人打造的主动式AI行政助理。Claude与你对话；Noah则与你的社交网络互动。它好比特斯拉的完全自动驾驶，而非定速巡航——一个自主的AI行政助理，管理你的日历、人际关系，以及跨邮件、短信和WhatsApp的后续跟进，确保万无一失。你可以把它想象成常驻于短信中的全天候行政助理，协助你处理会议后勤事务。
products.description: Noah is a proactive AI executive assistant for founders. Claude talks to you; Noah talks to your network. It's like Tesla Full Self Driving, and not cruise control- an autonomous AI EA that manages your calendar, relationships, and follow-ups across email, text, and WhatsApp - so nothing slips. Think of it as an always-on EA living in your SMS and helping you with meeting logistics.

products.name: Wondering
products.tagline: Duolingo for learning anything
products.summaryZh: 多邻国，学什么都行。
products.descriptionZh: 好奇是化繁为简、将复杂主题转化为可记忆且可应用知识的最愉快方式。告诉它你想学什么，它便会为你打造一条个性化学习路径，包含图文并茂的短课、播客和互动练习。它提炼出最重要的观点，让你以自己的方式探索，如同一位贴心的导师伴你左右。
products.description: Wondering is the most delightful way to break down complex topics into knowledge you can remember and apply. Tell it what you want to learn, and it creates a personalized path of short lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. It surfaces the most important ideas and lets you explore them in your own way, like a thoughtful tutor beside you.

products.name: Driven
products.tagline: The trusted AI investment agent, from insight to action
products.summaryZh: 可信赖的AI投资助手，从洞察到行动
products.descriptionZh: Driven是一款AI投资代理，将市场洞察转化为行动，而非仅仅提供答案。在一个由代理驱动的工作空间中，它整合了260多个API、内置及自定义技能、剧本、定时任务、全天候监控、实时数据、投资组合和订单流程。投资者无需切换工具或追逐每一个信号，即可在Driven中管理从创意生成、数据收集到分析与行动的完整流程。它是您的AI投资团队，而您始终掌控全局。
products.description: Driven is an AI investment agent that turns market insight into action, not just answers. In one agent-powered workspace, it combines 260+ APIs, built-in & custom Skills, Playbooks, scheduled tasks, 24/7 monitoring, real-time data, portfolios, and order workflows. Instead of switching tools or chasing every signal, investors can manage the full journey in Driven, from idea generation and data gathering to analysis and action. It’s your AI investment team, while you stay in control.

products.name: Atlaso
products.tagline: One memory for every AI you use
products.summaryZh: 每个你使用的AI，都有一份专属记忆。
products.descriptionZh: Atlaso是AI的记忆层。只需连接一次，你使用的每一个AI——从Claude Code到Cursor、Codex和ChatGPT——都会自动回忆起重要的上下文：你的项目、你的决策，以及你喜欢的工作方式。无需在每次会话开始时重新解释自己。一个共享的记忆，跟随你跨越所有工具，而不是被锁定在某个应用内。免费起步，并由原创记忆研究支持。
products.description: Atlaso is a memory layer for AI. Connect it once and every AI you use, from Claude Code to Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT, automatically recalls the context that matters: your projects, your decisions, and the way you like to work. No more re-explaining yourself at the start of every session. One shared memory that follows you across every tool, instead of being locked inside one app. Free to start, and backed by original memory research.

products.name: Vibe Buddy
products.tagline: Hardware for AI coding
products.summaryZh: AI 编程硬件
products.descriptionZh: Vibe Buddy是一款小型桌面机器人，让您在工作的同时，随时掌握Codex和Claude Code的使用限制及任务状态。无需打开额外标签页，即可了解您的AI何时在工作、需要您的输入、已完成或已达到使用上限。
products.description: Vibe Buddy is a small desktop robot that keeps Codex and Claude Code usage limits and task status visible while you work. See when your AI is working, needs your input, has finished, or has hit its usage limit—without opening another tab.

products.name: ZapDigits MCP
products.tagline: The MCP server for marketing data
products.summaryZh: 营销数据的MCP服务器
products.descriptionZh: 将Claude和ChatGPT连接到Google Analytics、Search Console、Meta Ads及30多个营销数据源。
products.description: Connect Claude and ChatGPT to Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Ads and 30+ marketing data sources.

products.name: VIDEO AI ME
products.tagline: Make videos and post them everywhere with just one tool
products.summaryZh: 用一个工具制作视频并发布到各个平台
products.descriptionZh: 大多数调度工具要求你在别处制作视频，然后下载并重新上传。VIDEO AI ME现在两者兼备：用AI生成UGC广告和产品视频，然后无需离开工具即可发布或排期到15个平台（TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、X、LinkedIn及其他10个）。AI根据你的实际脚本为每个平台撰写标题。一次批量排期25个视频。查看哪个视频在每个平台上表现最佳，然后一键转发或生成新版本。
products.description: Most schedulers make you create your videos somewhere else, then download and re-upload them. VIDEO AI ME now does both: generate UGC ads and product videos with AI, then publish or schedule them to 15 platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and 10 more) without leaving the tool. AI writes captions per platform from your actual script. Bulk schedule 25 videos in one sitting. See which video wins on each platform, then repost it or generate a new version with AI in one click.

products.name: GrowthBook 5.0
products.tagline: Build, ship, and improve at scale
products.summaryZh: 大规模构建、交付与改进。
products.descriptionZh: GrowthBook 5.0将功能开关、实验和产品分析整合到一个AI原生、数据仓库原生的平台中。通过新的AI可视化编辑器，在浏览器中构建无代码实验，让代理利用25个开源技能创建开关并起草实验，通过应用内AI助手探索产品数据，并以更强的治理能力安全发布。更快的查询和简化的实验工作流帮助每个团队以更少的摩擦从想法走向洞察。
products.description: GrowthBook 5.0 brings feature flags, experimentation, and product analytics into one AI-native, warehouse-native platform. Build no-code experiments in the browser with the new AI Visual Editor, let agents create flags and draft experiments with 25 open-source Skills, explore product data through the in-app AI Assistant, and ship safely with stronger governance. Faster queries and a streamlined experiment workflow help every team move from idea to insight with less friction.

products.name: Snipplet
products.tagline: Create and share beautiful guides from places you love
products.summaryZh: 创建并分享来自你所喜爱之处的精美指南
products.descriptionZh: 大多数旅行工具帮你规划行程，而Snipplet恰恰相反。它专为你已经去过并真心喜爱的地方设计。保存你最喜欢的去处，添加照片和小贴士，它就变成一份可通过一个链接分享的视觉指南。不再有零散的截图或47个标签页的Google文档。通过自定义字体、颜色、贴纸、背景和主题，让它成为你的专属。或者直接放入一张截图，让AI为你构建。真实的人，真实的推荐。适用于东京，也适用于你街角的最爱。
products.description: Most travel tools help you plan trips. Snipplet does the opposite. It's for places you've already been and actually loved. Save your favorite spots, add photos and tips, and it becomes a visual guide you can share with one link. No more scattered screenshots or 47 tab Google Docs. Make it yours with custom fonts, colors, stickers, backgrounds, and themes. Or drop a screenshot in and let AI build it for you. Real recs from real people. Works for Tokyo or your favorite spots around the corner.

products.name: Glasp MCP Connector
products.tagline: Search your highlights and notes inside Claude and ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 在Claude和ChatGPT中搜索你的高亮与笔记
products.descriptionZh: 将Glasp作为MCP服务器连接到Claude和ChatGPT。在AI助手中直接用自然语言搜索你的高亮和记忆。只读且仅对你可见。
products.description: Connect Glasp to Claude and ChatGPT as an MCP server. Search your highlights and memories in natural language, right inside your AI assistant. Read-only and private to you.

products.name: SpeakoFlow
products.tagline: Free, open-source voice dictation and AI assistant, offline
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源的语音听写与AI助手，离线可用。
products.descriptionZh: SpeakoFlow让你的声音覆盖整个桌面。说话，你的话语就能落入任何应用——邮件、编辑器、聊天、终端。说“Hey Flow”，它会根据屏幕上的内容写出完整回复。向助手询问你正在查看的内容，并听到回答。它还能清理你的口述内容，边说话边翻译，并学习你的工作方式。一切都可以在你的设备上运行——语音转文字始终如此。免费、开源、MIT许可。支持Windows、macOS、Linux。
products.description: SpeakoFlow puts your voice over your whole desktop. Speak, and your words land in any app — email, editor, chat, terminal. Say "Hey Flow" and it writes the whole reply from what's on your screen. Ask the assistant about what you're looking at and hear the answer back. It also cleans up your dictation, translates as you speak, and learns how you work. Everything can run on your machine — speech-to-text always does. Free, open source, MIT. Windows, macOS, Linux.

products.name: space ocr
products.tagline: OCR that checks its own answers, as an app or an API
products.summaryZh: 作为应用或API，能够自我校验答案的OCR技术
products.descriptionZh: Space OCR将收据、发票和表单的照片转换为可查询的表格。将照片拖入应用中的文件夹或发送至API，每一页即成为一行，可进行筛选和排序。每个值都显示其来源。每月免费100页。
products.description: space ocr turns photos of receipts, invoices and forms into a table you can query. Drop them into a folder in the app or send them to the API, and each page becomes a row you can filter and sort. Every value shows where it came from. 100 free pages a month.

products.name: Finyuus
products.tagline: A code-first language for durable, governed AI workflows
products.summaryZh: 面向持久、受治理AI工作流的代码优先语言
products.descriptionZh: Finyuus是一个代码优先的平台，用于构建、运行和管理AI工作流。它引入了一种基于缩进的轻量级DSL，用于组合代理、工具、防护、人工审批和嵌套工作流，并在Temporal上运行，支持重试、取消和重放。与可视化构建器不同，工作流以文本形式存储，便于基于Git的审查和差异比较。与提示链不同，每次运行都是持久化、版本化的，可通过Langfuse观察，并通过防护和人工审批进行治理。
products.description: Finyuus is a code-first platform for building, running, and governing AI workflows. It introduces a small indentation-based DSL for composing agents, tools, guards, human approvals, and nested workflows — then runs them on Temporal with retries, cancellation, and replayability. Unlike visual builders, workflows are stored as text for Git-based review and diffs. Unlike prompt chains, every run is durable, versioned, observable via Langfuse, and governable through guards and human approvals.

products.name: ScrollToll
products.tagline: Counts every Reel you watch, then locks the app.
products.summaryZh: 统计你观看的每条Reel，然后锁定应用。
products.descriptionZh: ScrollToll 统计你观看的每一条短视频——Reels、Shorts、TikTok——并在达到每日限额时强制锁定信息流。分钟是抽象的，视频数量则不然。要继续滑动，你得先完成一次引导式呼吸练习。Android 版。
products.description: ScrollToll counts every short video you watch — Reels, Shorts, TikTok — and hard-blocks the feed when you hit your daily limit. Minutes are abstract; a video count isn't. To keep scrolling you have to finish a guided breathing exercise first. Android.

products.name: Domo
products.tagline: Build and customize your own calendar agent you can text
products.summaryZh: 构建并定制你自己的日历代理，可通过短信交互。
products.descriptionZh: Domo是一款专为家庭日历打造的智能代理。它拥有独立的电话号码，可通过iMessage或短信发送指令（如“周四3点添加牙医预约”），并配备始终更新的墙面仪表盘。它基于原生Claude Code工具构建，运行在你现有的Claude订阅上：无需API密钥，无按token计费。安装方式是将指南交给编码代理即可。它既是一个产品，也是一种模式：替换用途，构建你自己的版本。我们公开开发过程；欢迎来看看别人在做什么。
products.description: Domo is a purpose-built agent that keeps your family calendar. It has its own phone number you iMessage or text ("add dentist Thursday at 3"), and an always-on wall dashboard that stays current. It's built with native Claude Code tooling and runs on your existing Claude subscription: no API key, no per-token bill. Install it by handing the guide to a coding agent. It's a pattern as much as a product: swap the purpose and build your own. We build in public; come see what others are making.

products.name: MOTHER
products.tagline: A terminal built for Claude Code w/ one-click session resume
products.summaryZh: 为Claude Code打造的终端，支持一键恢复会话
products.descriptionZh: 一款围绕Claude Code构建的原生macOS终端。项目启动器、一键恢复会话，以及Claude需要你时菜单栏的提醒。售价9.99美元。
products.description: A native macOS terminal built around Claude Code. Project launcher, one-click session resume, and a menu-bar alert when Claude needs you. $9.99.

products.name: Karve
products.tagline: The API client for developers on Windows
products.summaryZh: 面向Windows开发者的API客户端
products.descriptionZh: Karve是一款基于纯HTTP文件构建的原生Windows API客户端。冷启动时间低于2秒。在一个工作区内整理来自所有仓库的请求，切换环境变量，保留可搜索的历史记录。文件保存在磁盘上，支持Git。无需账户。一次购买，永久使用。
products.description: Karve is a native Windows API client built around plain http files. Cold start under 2 seconds. Organize requests from every repo in one workspace, switchenv environments, keep searchable history. Files stay on disk, Git-friendly. No account. Buy once.

products.name: Dashi Metrics
products.tagline: Visualize your revenue on a 3D globe
products.summaryZh: 在3D地球仪上可视化您的收入
products.descriptionZh: 见证您的业务焕发生机——每一位访客与每笔支付，都在动态3D地球仪上实时呈现。Dashi将静态仪表盘转化为生动的地理可视化视图，让全球趋势与客户活动即刻引人入胜。旋转、缩放，与实时数据互动。专为SaaS团队与创始人打造，助您获得可操作的视觉洞察，告别枯燥图表。
products.description: Watch your business come alive—every visitor and payment mapped in real time on a dynamic 3D globe. Dashi transforms static dashboards into live, geographic visualizations, making global trends and customer activity instantly engaging. Spin, zoom, and interact with your data as it happens. Perfect for SaaS teams and founders who want actionable, visual insights instead of boring charts.

products.name: Screen Awesome
products.tagline: The free screen recorder that cannot upload your video
products.summaryZh: 无法上传视频的免费屏幕录制工具
products.descriptionZh: 每个录屏工具都承诺不会滥用你的录制内容。Screen Awesome 无法做到这一点：它不请求任何主机权限，因此 Chrome 本身会阻止它访问任何服务器。安装前可在 chrome://extensions 中查看。将标签页、屏幕或摄像头录制为 MP4。自动缩放功能会让虚拟摄像头平滑跟随每次点击。截取区域或整页滚动截图。使用箭头、模糊、涂黑、步骤计数器和文本进行标注——全部为可编辑矢量。免费、无锁定、无需账户、无水印。
products.description: Every screen recorder promises not to misuse your recordings. Screen Awesome can't: it requests zero host permissions, so Chrome itself blocks it from reaching any server. Check it in chrome://extensions before you install. Record a tab, screen or camera to MP4. Auto-zoom glides a virtual camera to every click. Screenshot a region or a full scrolling page. Annotate with arrows, blur, redaction, step counters and text — all editable vectors. Free, unlocked, no account, no watermark.

products.name: Yokoso
products.tagline: Japanese for the life you're actually living in Japan
products.summaryZh: 为你在日本真实生活的日语
products.descriptionZh: 在日本生活中免费学习日语。Yokoso根据你的水平调整内容，在真实语境中教授标识、价格和语法，导入WaniKani进度，支持离线使用，无广告、无连续打卡、无锁定课程。
products.description: Free Japanese learning for real life in Japan. Yokoso adapts around what you know, teaches signs, prices and grammar in context, imports WaniKani progress, works offline, and has no ads, streaks or locked lessons.
